outcome: Scientific randomness now has one deterministic domain-separated foundation
owner_impact: Virtual Lab now uses one documented SplitMix64-based scientific RNG contract. Existing seeded Initialization results are preserved bit-for-bit, while simulator sensing randomness has its own deterministic domain stream. Scientific domains cannot advance each other's random sequence, reset/replay reconstructs streams from the run seed, and the controller domain is reserved for the next stochastic-controller capability. This ticket does not yet let Controller code draw probabilities.

next.text: Next is controller stochasticity with generic deterministic probability/distribution primitives. It will use the controller domain established here so aggregation controllers can make reproducible probabilistic decisions without host random APIs. That successor has not started.

technical_evidence: RNG contract vlab.rng/splitmix64-domain/1 is implemented in byte-identical browser/edge JavaScript plus the Rust/WASM kernel.
Root seed 2026 has fixed cross-runtime conformance vectors for initialization, sensing and reserved controller streams.
Initialization stream index 0 intentionally preserves the historical root SplitMix64 sequence, keeping existing seeded initial conditions unchanged.
Sensing noise now uses its own derived stream; future per-agent controller streams have a reserved independently derived domain.
The worker reports the active RNG contract version from the WASM kernel; raw stream state is not exposed to authoring/UI.
